column1: # Tabell: Netto kompensasjonsgrad ved arbeidsledighet for modellhusholdninger, etter varighet
# OECD-tittel: Net replacement rates in unemployment
# MEASURE (lik for alle rader): NHIDU=Net household income during unemployment
# UNIT_MEASURE (lik for alle rader): PT_INC_DISP_HH_BJL=Percentage of disposable household income before job loss
# AGE_CHILDREN (lik for alle rader): Y4_6=4 and 6 years
# REF_AREA: DEU=Germany; DNK=Denmark; FIN=Finland; GBR=United Kingdom; ISL=Iceland; NLD=Netherlands; NOR=Norway; OECD=OECD; SWE=Sweden; USA=United States
# HOUSEHOLD_TYPE: C_C0=Couple, no children; C_C2=Couple, 2 children; S_C0=Single person, no children; S_C2=Single person, 2 children
# INCOME_PREV: AW100=100% of average wage; AW67=67% of average wage
# INCOME_PART: AW100=100% of average wage; AW67=67% of average wage; MINW=Minimum wage; NOEARN_UNEMP_WO_CONBEN=No earnings, unemployed without contributory benefits; _Z=Not applicable
# UNEMP_DURATION: M12=12 months; M2=2 months; M60=60 months
